ModMetaData.name: Spine
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
The shared library the rest of my mods are built on. It does nothing by itself - install it because another mod asks for it.
- Alt-click a Spine mod's buttons, commands and labels to open its settings with the matching option already highlighted - Every CoolNether123 mod built on Spine supports that, and always will - Consistent settings pages with search and a Simple/Advanced split - Stable tooltips and bounded caching - Guarded Harmony patch installation, attributed to the mod that asked for it
Any modder can build on Spine and get the same behaviour in their own mod.
Requires Harmony. Load Spine before anything that depends on it.
